'''Ducks''' are [[bird]]s which are commonly found in [[rivers]] or lakes. They are very small, and are most often found on water, meaning they drop nothing, but if killed on land, they will drop [[bones]]. They are often found in the company of [[ducklings]] and [[drake]]s.

If the duck is next to the shore, the player can hit it with a [[melee]] weapon, but this occurrence is rare. Aside from using [[halberd]]s, players can usually only [[Ranged|range]] or [[Magic|mage]] them. Ducks found on land, such as those in [[Falador Park]], can be killed easily with any weapon.

Ducks can be fed by using [[breadcrumbs]] or [[duck food]], which are created by slicing [[bread]] or collected from the [[Sack of duck food]] south of Falador Park, respectively. Although there is no benefit to doing so with standard ducks, if a drake is fed over 21 breadcrumbs in 20 seconds, it will turn into [[Mega Duck]].

==Trivia==
* Killing a duck in Falador Park is one of the Falador easy tasks.
* The ducks appear to be of the {{Wp|mallard}} species.
* At one point ducks were removed from the minimap as yellow dots but later been reinstated. They have since been removed from the minimap again.
* Previously it was possible to gain prayer experience by killing ducks on water with a [[bonecrusher]].
* Feeding a duck with breadcrumbs or duck food has a 1/100 chance of the duck saying: {{RSChat|Cheers}}.
